records.name: Dragon Thunder
records.skill_description: A short-range anti-air Strike Super in which Omega Shenron extends the spikes on his back; a successful connection launches the opponent through a multi-hit attack.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference documents Dragon Thunder as an anti-air, short-range, 16-hit launching Strike Super. It can only connect when the opponent is above the user. The move is also categorized as a Counter Skill because of its reactive anti-air behavior.
records.acquisition_notes: Dragon Thunder is documented as unavailable for CaC and used by Omega Shenron and Omega Shenron (Supervillain). No supported Future Warrior unlock route is promoted.
records.pve_notes: Cast-exclusive skill; no CaC acquisition or Ultimate Finish route established.
records.pvp_notes: Anti-air and short-range reactive behavior are documented; exact frame and matchup values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
